filters.population: Rows in data/evidence/geo_hist.jsonl whose food_group is Rice or whose matrix contains rice.
filters.rice_matrix: Matrix slug contains rice, excluding slugs that contain non-rice. A mixed-meals slug qualifies only when the printed food name contains the word rice. An empty matrix qualifies only when the printed food name contains the word rice. Honey and cooking-oil slugs are not rice matrices.
filters.species: metal_species is exactly iAs or tAs. oAs, DMA, and MMA stay out. source_analyte_label is copied when the ledger printed one and is not used to relabel the species.
filters.country: sampling_country is present. Author affiliation, the jurisdictions array, an agency name, and a WHO region name are not sampling countries. Those exclusions were already applied by the geo-hist backfill.
filters.year: sampling_year_start or sampling_year_end is present. A start year that differs from the end year stays one row. The span is not expanded into calendar years.
filters.concentration: A concentration row has at least one copied numeric concentration field or a field_value_summary. A count-only row has coverage_kind count_only, a numeric n greater than zero, and no concentration field. No new statistic is computed. A count-only row that also carries a number is left out.
filters.not_copied: FDA Total Diet Study collection region, regulatory summary fields, certification-program fields, and extraction notes are not copied. sampling_region stays null unless the geo-hist row already has one.

reported.field_value_summary: Mean total arsenic 0.115 mg/kg dried weight for 70 rice samples. Harvest seasons 2018 and 2019 stay one span. The Red River Delta and the mining-activity zone are not separate rows. Micrograms per kilogram equal the printed milligrams per kilogram times 1000. The panel is total arsenic, not inorganic arsenic.
